objective: Add custom JWT authentication, tenant isolation middleware, and frontend auth flow to DukaanFlow
acceptance_criteria: Custom JWT auth with bcrypt password hashing and PyJWT token generation
Auth middleware verifies Bearer token on all protected routes
Tenant middleware derives business_id from authenticated user membership
User login endpoint (POST /api/v1/auth/login) returns JWT access token
Unauthenticated requests to protected routes return 401
User A cannot access User B's business records (cross-tenant IDOR protection)
CORS restricted to explicit origins only (remove wildcard)
Frontend login page with email/password form
Frontend auth context with token management and auto-redirect
Frontend API client wrapper attaches Bearer token to all requests
All existing 80 tests continue passing (backward compatible)
non_goals: Do not implement email verification or password reset in this phase
Do not modify existing financial logic or domain layer
